title: Chelsea's Scott chase: bold January bid or rushed mistake?
body:
Chelsea are being linked with a move for Bournemouth's Scott, and the report says they will push to sign him in January [S1].

The interest is not one-sided. A later round of newspaper coverage says Arsenal and Liverpool are also chasing the Bournemouth player [S2]. That makes this a crowded chase, and a crowded chase tends to push prices up and tempers up.

The form guide sharpens the picture. Chelsea have 2 wins and 3 defeats from their last five league games, collecting 6 points, scoring 5 and conceding 7 [ST1]. Bournemouth have won all five, taking 15 points, scoring 11 and conceding 1 [ST2]. The side pursuing the player is in a rough patch, while the club holding him is in fine fettle, so any bid has to be made from a position of need, not strength [ST1][ST2].

If this one goes through, it says plenty about where the club thinks it is heading. But the smart money is on patience.

The Touchline Take: judge the business when the window shuts, not before.
